data.name: renu.earth
data.description: Renu Earth, Inc. is a US-incorporated biochar carbon-removal company operating a pilot project in partnership with a major sawmill in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. It converts sustainable wood residues from the sawmill into biochar, generating Puro.earth-certified CORCs tracked via Carbonfuture's dMRV system, with Carbonfuture committed to purchase the initial 1,000 CORCs and broker up to 102,000 CORCs yearly. The company plans to expand to 10 additional sawmill sites with a projected annual capacity of 200,000 CORCs by 2027.
